lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in discrete vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Inter-blob distance increases linearly along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a geometric grid; primary nodes are defined by maximal diameter high-luminance blobs at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper lateral flank, defined by a high-luminance upper edge transitioning sharply to a low-luminance shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed irregularly across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Hyper-dense region of micro-diameter high-luminance pixels located in the transitional zone between the fifth gill slit and the primary lateral flank grid.
